title: My Never-ceasing Songs Shall Show
description: My Never-ceasing Songs Shall Show in Tonic Solfa to YORK, doh is F: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: Isaac Watts wrote these words for The Psalms of David Imitated in the Language of the New Testament (1719): Psalm 89, part 2, headed “The faithfulness of God”.
Watts' psalms were printed without tunes and sung to any tune of their metre, Common Metre (8.6.8.6). This page sets the words to YORK; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: My nev-er ceas-ing songs shall show The mer-cies of the Lord, And make suc-ceed-ing a-ges know How faith-ful is his word.

lines: The sacred truths his lips pronounce
And if he speak a promise once,
How long the race of David held
But there's a nobler covenant seal'd
His seed for ever shall possess
The meanest subject of his grace
Lord God of hosts, thy wondrous ways
And saints on earth their honours raise

source: Isaac Watts, The Psalms of David Imitated (1719)
licence: Public domain: Isaac Watts died in 1748.
credits: Words by Isaac Watts (1674–1748), public domain; set to YORK by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
